tools.name: check_dependency_vulnerabilities
tools.description:
Check a list of dependencies for known vulnerabilities using the GitHub Security Advisory Database.
This tool queries the GitHub Advisory Database to find known security vulnerabilities affecting the specified packages.

Use this tool when:
- You want to check if project dependencies have known vulnerabilities
- You are adding a new dependency to a project and should check it is safe before adding to the project

The tool accepts owner, repo, and a list of dependencies with their ecosystems and versions, then returns any matching security advisories with upgrade recommendations where available.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem (case-insensitive; GitHub Actions also accepts github-actions)

dependencies.description: List of dependencies to check for vulnerabilities

tools.name: github_support_docs_search
tools.description: Retrieve documentation relevant to answer GitHub product and support questions. Support topics include: GitHub Actions Workflows, Authentication, GitHub Support Inquiries, Pull Request Practices, Repository Maintenance, GitHub Pages, GitHub Packages, GitHub Discussions, Copilot Spaces

query.description: Input from the user about the question they need answered. This is the latest raw unedited user message. You should ALWAYS leave the user message as it is, you should never modify it.

tools.name: create_pull_request_with_copilot
tools.description: Perform task with GitHub Copilot coding agent

owner.description: Repository owner. You can guess the owner, but confirm it with the user before proceeding.

repo.description: Repository name. You can guess the repository name, but confirm it with the user before proceeding.

problem_statement.description: Detailed description of the task to be performed (e.g., 'Implement a feature that does X', 'Fix bug Y', etc.)

title.description: Title for the pull request that will be created

base_ref.description: Git reference (e.g., branch) that the agent will start its work from. If not specified, defaults to the repository's default branch
